messages.ko: 오늘 넥스트 생일이잖아~~~ 많이 축하해줘서 고마워 작년 이맘때쯤 나는 내가 공개된걸보고 설렘반 두려움반 두근두근했었던거같아 내가 데뷔라니!! 이런마음에 꿈인가 현실인가 오히려 무덤덤했었을수도 있어 ㅎㅎ 팬분들을 처음만날때도 프롬을 처음시작할때도 너무 서투르고 어색해서 뚝딱거렸을텐데 웨이브가 오히려 내 긴장을 풀어줬어 많이 부족했던 1년전 하연이를 좋아해줘서 고맙고 조금이지만 성장해있는 지금의 나도 좋아해줘서 고마워 우리의 사이가 1년이라도 깊어졌다는 사실이 너무 좋다 두서없이 내 마음을 표현하다보니 전달이 잘 안될수도 있지만 내맘 알거라고 생각해~~😘지금의 나를 있게 만들어줘서 고마워 그리고 곧 크리스마스잖아 올해 우는일은 많이 없었지? 그래야 선물받지이 우는일이 많았다면 올해는 없었으면 좋겠다 기쁨의 눈물은 허락해줄게 나쁜산타는 우는사람한테 엄격하지만 착한산타는 그런건 신경안쓴데
messages.en: Today is NXT's birthday~~~ Thank you so much for celebrating it with me. Around this time last year, when I saw myself being revealed, I think I was half excited and half scared, my heart was racing. Me... debuting!! I wondered if this was a dream or reality, and I might have even felt strangely numb about it ㅎㅎ. When I first met the fans and when I first started using Fromm, I was so awkward and clumsy, but WAV actually helped me relax. Thank you for loving the Hayeon from a year ago, who still had so many shortcomings, and thank you for loving the me of today, who's grown even if only a little. I'm so happy that our bond has become deeper over the past year. I might not be expressing my feelings very well because I'm just writing whatever comes to mind, but I think you know how I feel~~😘 Thank you for making me who I am today. And Christmas is coming soon, right? You didn't cry too much this year, did you? That's how you get presents. If you cried a lot this year, I hope there won't be any more tears. I'll allow tears of happiness. Bad Santa is strict with people who cry, but Good Santa doesn't worry about things like that.
I guess I'm a good Santa.

messages.ko: 1년전 하연이는 나를 좋아해주는 이렇게 많은 사람들이 생길거라곤 상상도 못했겠지만 너의 주변엔 이렇게 좋은사람들이 많이 생겼다는걸 1년전 하연이한테 말해주고싶넹
messages.en: The Hayeon from a year ago could never have imagined that so many people would come to love me, but I'd love to tell the Hayeon from a year ago that so many wonderful people would come into your life.
Let's make this one the 1st anniversary gift.
To celebrate how much I've grown.
Let's have a happy end of the year.
